In Tenable Vulnerability Management, you can customize Tenable's risk management framework to
fit the needs of your organization. To do this, you can create rules to modify the severity of
vulnerabilities or the results of host audits or to hide them from your scan results.
Use the API endpoints to perform standard CRUD operations on recast rules.
For more information about recast rules, see Recast Rules in the Tenable Vulnerability Management
User Guide.
